faqs.q: What is WPC and how is it different from wood?
faqs.a: WPC (Wood Plastic Composite) is made from wood fibre and polymer. Unlike conventional wood, Greenplastwood products are 100% water proof, termite & borer proof and fire retardant, so they do not swell, crack or rot. In lab tests our WPC showed only 0.2% water absorption and a UL-94 V-0 flammability rating.

faqs.q: Which products does Greenplastwood manufacture?
faqs.a: WPC Chaukhat (door frames), WPC Window Frames, WPC Doors (solid, 3 layer, texture and digital print), WPC Sheets & Boards (WPC / PVC boards and 3 layer boards), PVC Panel and, from SNG Eco India, Recycled Plastic Sheet.

faqs.q: Do you supply across India and for bulk projects?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply across India through 50+ stock points and take bulk project orders with custom sizes and colours. Call or WhatsApp us for a quote.

title: About WPC
Chaukhat
paragraphs: A chaukhat is the frame fixed in the wall that carries the door. It is also the part that fails first: it stands on a wet floor and it is the first thing termites reach. Greenplastwood chaukhats are made of wood plastic composite (WPC) at 750 to 1200 kg/m³, so they do not absorb water, swell or rot.

They are worked like wood. Your carpenter cuts, joins and screws them with the same tools, and the frame can be painted, polished or laminated. Choose single or double rebate, three profile models, four lengths and eight colours. Sizes and colours can be customised on bulk orders.

faqs.q: What sizes are WPC chaukhats available in?
faqs.a: Single rebate frames come in 75 × 50, 100 × 50, 100 × 63, 125 × 63 and 150 × 63 mm, plus 60 × 30, 65 × 40, 90 × 45 and 90 × 63 mm. Double rebate frames come in 120 × 50, 125 × 63 and 150 × 63 mm. Standard lengths are 7, 8, 9 and 10 ft. Sizes can be customised on bulk orders.

faqs.q: What is the difference between single and double rebate?
faqs.a: The rebate is the step cut into the frame where the door shutter sits. A single rebate frame has one step and takes one door. A double rebate frame has a step on both sides, so two shutters can hang in the same opening, for example a main door and a mesh door.

faqs.q: Which model should I choose: Mould & Groove, Mould & Plain or Square?
faqs.a: They change the look of the frame edge, not its strength. Mould & Groove has a rounded edge with grooves on the back face, Mould & Plain has a rounded edge with a plain back, and Square has straight edges for a flat, modern look.

faqs.q: Are WPC chaukhats suitable for bathrooms and kitchens?
faqs.a: Yes. Greenplastwood WPC chaukhats are 100% water proof and moisture proof, so they do not swell, rot or warp in bathrooms, kitchens or other humid areas.

faqs.q: Do WPC chaukhats need anti-termite treatment?
faqs.a: No. The frames are termite and borer proof and bacteria and fungus resistant, so no chemical treatment is needed.

faqs.q: What is the density of Greenplastwood chaukhats?
faqs.a: Chaukhats are made at 750 to 1200 kg/m³. In lab testing by Alekh Plastics Testing Centre (Nov 2022) a door-frame sample showed 0.90 g/cc density, 0.2% water absorption, a UL-94 V-0 flammability rating and 2236 N screw withdrawal force.

faqs.q: Which colours are available?
faqs.a: Light Ivory, Yellow Ivory, Pure White, Beach White, Teak Wood, Chocolate Brown, Coco Brown and Black. Other (NFC) colours can be made on bulk orders.

faqs.q: Can a WPC chaukhat be painted or polished?
faqs.a: Yes. The frame can be painted, polished or laminated, and polishing costs less than on wood. Regular re-polishing is not needed.

faqs.q: How is a WPC chaukhat installed?
faqs.a: The same way as a wooden one. The posts and head are cut, joined at the corners and fixed in the wall opening with screws, using normal carpentry tools.

faqs.q: Can sizes be customised?
faqs.a: Yes. Size, length, density and colour can be customised on bulk orders. Send us your drawing or requirement.

title: About WPC
Window Frame
paragraphs: A window frame sits in an outside wall, so it takes rain on one side and sun on the other. Wooden frames swell, then shrink, then the paint cracks and termites get in. A WPC frame does not absorb water and is not attacked by termites or borers, so it stays the size it was fitted.

Greenplastwood makes two window frame profiles, 70 × 30 mm and 120 × 50 mm, in 7 to 10 ft lengths and the same eight colours as our door chaukhats. They are cut, screwed, polished or laminated like wood. Profiles, lengths and colours can be customised on bulk orders.

faqs.q: Are WPC window frames good for exterior walls?
faqs.a: Yes. WPC is 100% water proof and weather and ageing resistant, and our catalogue lists it as best used as an exterior-grade material. It does not rot, swell or get termites like a wooden window frame.

faqs.q: Which colours can I choose?

faqs.q: Can WPC window frames be painted or polished?

faqs.q: What is the density?

faqs.q: How is a WPC window frame installed?
faqs.a: Like a wooden one. The frame members are cut, joined at the corners with screws and fixed in the wall opening, using normal carpentry tools.

faqs.q: Do WPC window frames need termite treatment?

title: About WPC
Doors
paragraphs: A wooden or flush door in a bathroom swells at the bottom, then stops closing. A WPC door does not absorb water, so it keeps its size and shape in bathrooms, kitchens and washed-down corridors, and termites and borers do not attack it.

Greenplastwood makes two constructions. Solid doors are a single WPC core, 17 to 35 mm thick. 3 layer doors add a rigid PVC skin on both faces for buildings where doors take heavy daily use. Both come in five standard sizes, and thickness, width, length and density can be customised on bulk orders.

faqs.q: What sizes and thickness do WPC doors come in?
faqs.a: Standard sizes are 27 × 78, 30 × 81, 33 × 84, 36 × 81 and 38 × 84 inches. Solid doors are made in 17, 18, 24, 25, 28, 30, 32 and 35 mm thickness, and 3 layer doors in 24, 25, 28, 30, 32 and 35 mm. Thickness, width, length and density can be customised on bulk orders.

faqs.q: Are WPC doors good for bathrooms?
faqs.a: Yes. WPC doors are 100% water proof and do not swell, rot or get termites, which is why they are the usual choice for bathroom and kitchen doors.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a solid door and a 3 layer door?
faqs.a: A solid door is a single WPC core at 550 kg/m³, 17 to 35 mm thick. A 3 layer door has a 600 kg/m³ WPC core between two rigid PVC outer layers of 0.8 to 1 mm, 24 to 35 mm thick, for a harder and smoother surface.

faqs.q: Where are 3 layer doors used?
faqs.a: Hotel room doors, school and classroom doors, office doors, interior and main doors, bathroom doors and children's room doors: anywhere a door gets heavy daily use.

faqs.q: What is the density of a WPC door?
faqs.a: Solid doors are 550 kg/m³ and 3 layer doors have a 600 kg/m³ core; both can be made up to 750 kg/m³ on order. A lab-tested door and board sample showed 0.66 g/cc density, 0.2% water absorption, a UL-94 V-0 rating and 65 MPa compressive strength.

faqs.q: Which designs are available?
faqs.a: Plain colour doors, six texture designs (SG-001 to SG-006) and digital print designs (SGD-009 to SGD-152). Share the design code when you enquire.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order for coloured doors?
faqs.a: Ivory is the regular colour. Other colours are made on a minimum order of 300 doors.

faqs.q: Can a WPC door be cut and fitted by a carpenter?
faqs.a: Yes. WPC is sawn, cut and screwed with traditional carpentry tools, and it holds screws well. A lab-tested door and board sample showed a screw withdrawal force of 1565 N.

faqs.q: Can door sizes be customised?
faqs.a: Yes. Thickness, width, length and density can be customised on bulk orders.

title: About WPC
Sheets & Boards
paragraphs: Plywood in a kitchen or bathroom takes in water at the edges, the layers open up and termites follow. A WPC board does not absorb water and has nothing for termites to eat, so cabinets under a sink or next to a shower stay as they were built.

The boards are worked like plywood. They are sawn, routed, screwed, glued and laminated with normal carpentry tools. Greenplastwood makes single-layer WPC / PVC boards from 5 mm and 3 layer boards from 6 mm, both in the standard 8 ft × 4 ft sheet, and both free of formaldehyde and lead.

faqs.q: Is a WPC board better than plywood for kitchens?
faqs.a: For wet areas, yes. WPC boards are 100% water proof, termite and borer proof and do not swell or shrink, while plywood absorbs moisture and needs treatment. WPC is still cut, screwed, glued and laminated like plywood.

faqs.q: What thickness and size do WPC boards come in?
faqs.a: WPC / PVC boards are made in 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 17 and 18 mm thickness, and 3 layer boards in 6 to 18 mm. The standard size is 8 ft × 4 ft. Other sizes can be made on big orders.
faqs.changed: Corrected to 5–18 mm per client PDF (old page text listed up to 35 mm).

faqs.q: What is the density of a WPC board?
faqs.a: WPC / PVC boards are 450 to 600 kg/m³ and 3 layer boards 550 to 600 kg/m³; both can be made up to 750 kg/m³ on order. A lab-tested door and board sample showed 0.66 g/cc density, 0.2% water absorption, a UL-94 V-0 rating, 23 MPa flexural strength and 1565 N screw withdrawal force.

faqs.q: What is a WPC 3 layer board?
faqs.a: A board built in three layers for a harder and smoother finish than a single-layer board, with the same water proof and termite proof properties. It is used for kitchens, wardrobes, office furniture and partitions.

faqs.q: Which colours are available and what is the minimum order?
faqs.a: WPC / PVC boards: White, Red, Ivory, Orange, Coco Brown, Dark Grey, Yellow, Blue and Green, with a minimum of 100 sheets per colour and thickness. 3 layer boards: White is standard, with Ivory, Brown and WPC colour; bulk orders start at 9 tons.

faqs.q: Can WPC boards be laminated?
faqs.a: Yes. The surface is smooth and takes glue and laminate. Lamination is done as per your design.

faqs.q: Can a carpenter work with WPC boards?
faqs.a: Yes. They are sawn, cut and screwed with traditional carpentry tools and hold screws well.

title: Installation And
Care
installation.lead: The steps from our PVC panel guide. Panels are pre-finished, so there is no polish or paint after fitting.

steps.title: Prepare the wall
steps.text: The plaster should be dry and flat. If the wall is damp or uneven, fix a light aluminium or WPC batten grid at 300 mm centres first.

steps.title: Fix the starting trim
steps.text: Fix the L-angle or J-trim along the skirting and the side corner with countersunk screws.

steps.title: Place the first panel
steps.text: Slot it into the starting trim and check it is plumb with a spirit level.

steps.title: Fix the edge
steps.text: Fasten the groove edge to the wall or frame with clips or fine countersunk screws. No screws show on the finished face.

steps.title: Interlock the next panel
steps.text: Slide its tongue into the groove until it sits tight, and repeat across the wall.

steps.title: Cut and finish
steps.text: Cut panels with a fine-tooth saw and finish the top and corner joints with matching edge profiles.

installation.care: Dust with a soft cloth or wipe with a damp cloth and mild soap. The surface is stain resistant and needs no polish, coating or touch-up.
installation.wet_areas: The panels are 100% water and moisture resistant, so they can be used in kitchens and bathrooms.

faqs.q: What sizes do PVC panels come in?
faqs.a: Three interior series: 12 mm 2G panels are 200 mm × 2900 mm; 15 mm 8G and 24 mm panels are 165 mm × 2900 mm. Exterior PVC panels are 215 × 25 or 26 mm in 8 ft and 10 ft lengths.

faqs.q: How many designs are available?
faqs.a: 63 designs: 21 in each of the 200, 300 and 100 series, in wood grains, marble, stone and solid colours. Share the design code, for example 201 or 325, when you enquire.

faqs.q: Which series should I choose?
faqs.a: For rooms with a 9 to 10 ft ceiling, 12 mm 2G or 15 mm 8G gives balanced proportions. The 24 mm profile is generally chosen for taller walls and larger spaces, where the deeper flutes can be seen from a distance. This is general guidance; our team can advise for your wall.

faqs.q: Can PVC panels be used in bathrooms and kitchens?
faqs.a: Yes. The panels are 100% water and moisture resistant and easy to clean, so they suit kitchens, bathrooms and other humid areas.

faqs.q: Are PVC panels suitable for exterior walls?
faqs.a: Yes. Exterior PVC panels, 215 mm wide, are made for facades, elevations and ceilings and do not rot, deform or fade.

faqs.q: How are PVC panels installed?
faqs.a: On a dry, flat wall the first panel is set into a starting trim and checked for plumb, then each panel is fixed along its edge and the next panel slides into it, so no screws show. On an uneven or damp wall a batten frame is fixed first.

faqs.q: Do PVC panels need polishing or painting?
faqs.a: No. All 63 designs come pre-finished, so there is no polish, coating or touch-up.

faqs.q: How do I clean them?
faqs.a: Dust with a soft cloth or wipe with a damp cloth and mild soap. The surface is stain resistant.

faqs.q: What is a Greenplastwood recycled plastic sheet?
faqs.a: It is a solid sheet made from recycled plastic by SNG Eco India Pvt. Ltd., the company behind Greenplastwood. It is used mainly as a pallet in fly ash brick and paver block plants, and in place of traditional shuttering ply in construction.

faqs.q: Which sizes and thicknesses are available?
faqs.a: Brick pallets are made in 16, 18, 20, 25 and 50 mm thickness, in 600 × 600, 600 × 700, 800 × 850 and 950 × 750 mm. Paver block pallets are made in 8 and 12 mm, in 1220 × 1220, 1220 × 620 and 610 × 610 mm, plus 2440 × 120 mm as listed in our catalogue. Other sizes can be made on bulk orders.

faqs.q: Will the pallets work on my machine?
faqs.a: Yes. Our catalogue lists them as suitable for all machine types used for fly ash bricks: automatic, semi-automatic and manual. Tell us your machine and pallet size and we will confirm.

faqs.q: How long do the pallets last?
faqs.a: They are water proof, termite proof and rust proof, and in tests they showed no swelling after 72 hours of boiling and no delamination after 4 hours of boiling and 4 hours of air drying. They are made for long life and repeated use.

faqs.q: What is the 20% buy back?
faqs.a: Our catalogue offers a buy back at 20% for Greenplastwood pallets. Ask our team for the current terms when you order.
